description: This file defines a class 'HierarchyTreeBuilder' used to construct hierarchy tree nodes in a UI context, likely for testing purposes within the Android project. It includes imports, class properties, setter methods following builder pattern, and a build method to create a 'HierarchyTreeNode' object with the configured properties.

classes.name: HierarchyTreeBuilder
classes.description: Builder class to construct 'HierarchyTreeNode' objects with customizable properties for testing or construction purposes.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the hierarchy node.

methods.name: setKind
methods.description: Sets the kind/type of the hierarchy node.

methods.name: setStableId
methods.description: Sets the stable identifier for the node.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the node.

methods.name: setShortName
methods.description: Sets an optional short name for the node.

methods.name: setChips
methods.description: Sets an array of chips associated with the node.

methods.name: setDiffType
methods.description: Sets the difference type, possibly for version comparison.

methods.name: setIsVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the node.

methods.name: setVisibleView
methods.description: Configures the view setting for visibility.

methods.name: setFilteredView
methods.description: Configures whether the node shows in filtered view.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns a 'HierarchyTreeNode' object with the configured properties.

ctags.name: node
ctags.pattern: /^    const node = new HierarchyTreeNode(this.name, this.kind, this.stableId, this.children);$/
